name: Frozen R2 prepared-projection execution-scope validation
registration: After kernel-only held-out results and before the first full-grid prepared-candidate timing
weights: All registered held-out layers/projections plus the retained tied head, unchanged native BF16 checkpoint bits
activations: Controlled synthetic native BF16 data, seed919, same activation policy as the kernel-only study
accumulation: FP32, no TF32 or reduced-precision BF16 reductions
primary_regime: Performance power profile on AC, stock GPU, original kernel-evidence runtime/context/memory-clock bindings
physical_weight_ring: At least max(80MiB,20*L2) distinct original weight bytes; independent packed copies when selected
selection: Only each shape's complete three-process kernel gate may select the frozen coded configuration as a benchmark candidate. Other shapes use a dtype-correct native vendor fallback. Actual poor compression disables coded selection.

graph_arms.strong_vendors: Retain every original frozen eligible candidate and its own A/A twin, including original head pools; no new algorithm search
graph_arms.prepared: Checked prepared linear_out with selected frozen custom candidate or vendor fallback
graph_arms.prepared_direct: Same underlying checked kernel/native operation, same physical buffers and frozen configuration
graph_arms.prepared_direct_aa: Independent direct-operation timing arm for implementation-overhead A/A
graph_arms.forced_custom_diagnostics: Unchanged measure_case raw/coded measurements remain visible; never confuse these with the selected fallback

controls: Native Torch-only wrapper-overhead controls. The unused forced custom diagnostic uses fixed coded_t64_v8 and is never selected, tuned or accepted.
eager_arms: Allocation-including synchronized nativeTorch/vendor twin versus selected allocating candidate API. Explicitly separate from graph comparison against the full frozen vendor pool. No GPU monitoring during eager timings.
numerical_checks: Unchanged FP64 oracle, every captured output checked, exact weight preservation and prepared/direct bitwise parity; allocating eager outputs checked separately outside timing
overhead_gate: Per case: absolute direct A/A<=1% and paired95% lower latency-saved bound>=-1%, with numerical and context checks. All registered controls must pass for a scope to qualify.
performance_gate: Original strict per-shape kernel gate>10% remains necessary; no report-level or fallback custom-win claim
reporting: All136 cases per output, every failure, raw rounds, graph/eager contexts, storage/setup/packing, input/source/runtime/protocol hashes and provisional per-shape outcomes. No implementation promotion or retry until pass. Later guarded integration requires independent evidence review.
